svg.text: Conceptual debt is bad if never paid
You expect to know by 12 November 2026
Two teams stop waiting on each other
↓ the story continues as you scroll
Wide pane — the story moves beside the rest
You expect to know by 12 November 2026
Two teams stop waiting on each other
Where it stands, and four counts that open where they are read — never a grade.
One next step, finished in place, with an Undo.
Its neighbourhood: colour is the relation, a dashed note is near but not linked.
What surrounds it: counted, collapsible, one heading level; empty ones fold into one line.
Its story, newest first; the pinned day reads as a date, never a countdown.
